title.narrative: Increased capacity of constituents, partners and stakeholders to implement sectoral international labour standards, codes of practice, guidelines and tools

description.narrative: The following are the major global deliverables and activities of the ILO in this policy area: (1) Preparation of new sectoral codes of practice, guidelines and other tools and facilitation of sectoral meetings of experts and technical meetings endorsed by the ILO Governing Body, ensuring implementation of its conclusions (2) Delivery of sector-specific capacity development programmes, including in collaboration with the Turin Centre. (3) Promotion of the ratification and application of sector-specific standards and tools, including through partnerships with other UN entities, multilateral organizations and coordination mechanisms. (4) Dissemination of knowledge on good practices and lessons learned in relation to the implementation of international labour standards and other tools in specific economic sectors for crisis response, recovery and resilience, with particular attention to gender equality (5) Support to regions in analysing challenges and opportunities of different economic sectors and identification of target sectors in regions and countries.
